PEACH-TO-INDIGO BANDS: a graded sky stepped in wide dithered bands, warm apricot at the horizon rising through rose and lilac to a deep indigo crown
GOLD-TO-TEAL BANDS: broad dithered steps climb from a honeyed gold at the base through amber and seafoam to a cool teal dome above
ROSE-TO-VIOLET BANDS: wide pixel bands sweep upward from a blush rose through dusty mauve and lavender to a rich violet at the crown
AMBER-TO-DEEP-BLUE BANDS: stepped dithered colour lifts from a warm amber horizon through tangerine and slate to a soft deep blue overhead
CORAL-TO-MIDNIGHT BANDS: a grand dithered gradient rises from coral through salmon and periwinkle to a hushed midnight blue at the top
COTTON PUFFS AT DUSK: three well-spaced rounded puffs float in a peachy sky, each one rim-lit in warm gold along its upper curve
AFTERNOON CLOUD PUFFS: generous puffs of bright white drift wide apart across a clear blue field, their soft undersides shaded in pale lavender
SILVER-RIMMED PUFFS: four pillowy clouds rest high and separate in an open cyan sky, each trimmed with a silver-white pixel highlight on top
ROSY CLOUD PUFFS: rounded cotton-soft masses float with room to breathe in a lilac sky, their crowns catching a warm blush of light
GREAT LOW MOON: a large round moon sits close to the horizon, pale cream and softly dithered, circled by a thin luminous halo ring
HIGH SOFT MOON: a huge full moon high in a deep blue sky, its round face gently stippled and ringed with a faint pearlescent glow
AMBER HALO MOON: a broad round moon glows low and warm in an indigo dusk, its dithered edge blending into a wide amber halo band
STAR FIELD AND GALAXY: a scatter of sharp pixel stars fills a deep crown, a pale soft arc of galaxy dust curving gently across the dome
BRIGHT FOUR-POINT STARS: a handful of bright four-point pixel stars punctuate a dark teal sky alongside a soft haze of smaller scattered white points
GALAXY DUST ARC: a wide pale band of dithered galaxy dust arcs across a deep violet sky, flanked by dozens of tiny crisp pixel stars
HIGH FEATHERED STREAKS: thin combed cloud strands curve in long pale arcs across a graded periwinkle blue, fanning gently toward the crown
CIRRUS SWEEP: delicate feathered streaks trail high across a soft cyan sky, their pale wisps drawn in fine combed pixel lines that thin at each end
PALE ARC STREAKS: long thin feathered clouds stretch in gentle parallel arcs over a graded blue field, pale as silk and softly luminous
PEARL LAYER WITH WARM BREAK: a soft even pearl-white cloud layer covers the sky with a single warm golden gap letting rose and amber through
BRIGHT CLOUD BREAK: a gentle continuous cloud sheet glows soft ivory, parted by one clear warm breach that shows a sweep of turquoise beyond
LUMINOUS GAP IN THE OVERCAST: a smooth pale overcast spreads across the dome, opening in one wide patch to a flush of apricot and soft blue
LOW HORIZON BAND: a soft dark cloud band rests along the far horizon while a clean graded blue climbs upward, brightening to cyan at the dome
DISTANT CLOUD SHELF: a low band of muted blue-grey cloud hugs the far horizon beneath a wide open sky dithered from powder blue to deep cerulean
AURORA CURTAIN: a rippling curtain of soft mint and rose shimmer high in a deep dithered sky, pale pixel stars glinting between each fold
SOFT AURORA VEIL: gentle waves of aqua and lavender undulate across a deep indigo dome, with small bright pixel stars showing clearly through the curtain
